description: Client-side Fabric mod that renders item frames and map walls (ImageFrame, map art) much faster, with no visual difference. Now available on Modrinth.

mods.name: Fast ImageFrames
mods.description: Client-side only. Makes item frames and map walls (ImageFrame, map art) much cheaper to render, with no visual difference. Works with ImageFrame Client, Sodium and Iris.

releases.notes:
Fast ImageFrames 1.7.2 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric).

**Overall: Better performance and new features.**

Added since B1.5.0:
- Smooth maps seen at an angle or from far away (mipmaps), with a new slider in the settings.
- Map previews in the inventory and tooltips, smoother and cheaper to draw.
- Baked item frames are skipped by the entity render loop (entity pass about 20-37% faster with Iris).
- Occlusion results are cached, no longer flushed on every light or section change.
- Frames that do not change are checked less often.
- Fixes: wall blinking when a frame loads into a baked section, ghost blocks with Sodium.
